objective.statement: Add a pie chart widget to HomeView.tsx, the same overall size as the torus widget, drawn from fake data.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView renders a pie chart widget that shows a pie built from fake, hard-coded data.
The pie chart widget has the same overall size as the torus widget (200px by 200px outer box).

The widget has an accessible name and visible label 'Pie Chart Widget', distinct from the torus widget names, and the pie slices and their values are available to assistive technology as text, not by colour alone.
The existing torus widgets and the rest of HomeView are unchanged.

in.statement: Add a PieChartWidget component with test ids and component tests, and render it in HomeView.tsx with a HomeView component test.

out.statement: New dependencies (no chart library), real or remote data, interactivity, TorusWidget changes, other HomeView sections, and historical workflow records.

observations.statement: The torus widget is a 200px by 200px section (WIDGET_SIZE_PX in TorusWidget.tsx) with a 150px graphic above a text label. The pie widget copies that box and layout so the overall size matches.

The pie is hand-built inline SVG with a hard-coded fake dataset in the component (four slices, for example Alpha 40, Beta 30, Gamma 20, Delta 10), so no dependency is needed. Slice paths are computed from the values.
Placement: rendered inside the existing torus row, after the two torus widgets, so the widgets sit side by side. The card says only 'on the HomeView.tsx'.

Slice colours use a fixed categorical palette of distinct hexes. A visually hidden list under the chart gives each slice name and percentage, so the data is not colour-only. Visible label stays 'Pie Chart Widget'.

provenance.source: Card text: New Feature Pie Chart Widget - On the HomeView.tsx, make a pie chart widget. Make it the same overall size as the torus widget. Use some fake data for the pie chart. Plan approval required.
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve the plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Plan is saved and valid at the planned gate; waiting for the owner.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Static presentational widget; the fake dataset is a module constant.
Data is fake and local; no remote data involved.

unit.rationale: Slice geometry stays inside the component and is covered through rendered output; no separate logic module.

component.rationale: Rendered output of PieChartWidget and HomeView is the behaviour under change.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour; the HomeView component test renders the real PieChartWidget.

e2e.rationale: Static markup addition with no user flow.

increments.behavior: PieChartWidget renders a 200px by 200px labelled section with a pie of four fake-data slices and a text list of slice names and percentages.
HomeView renders the pie chart widget in the torus row after the two torus widgets, leaving the torus widgets unchanged.
increments.doneWhen: The HomeView component test passes, and the full component suite, lint and build still pass.

tests.description: PieChartWidget (src/components/pie-chart-widget/PieChartWidget.component.test.tsx): region named 'Pie Chart Widget' with visible label; outer box style 200px by 200px, matching the torus widget; one path per fake slice, with fills from the fixed palette and arc sizes proportional to the values (percentages sum to 100); text list names every slice with its percentage.
HomeView renders one 'Pie Chart Widget' region inside the torus row, after the green and blue torus widgets, and the torus widgets and their accessible names are unchanged.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: PieChartWidget module does not exist, so the test file fails to import it.
HomeView renders no pie chart widget, so no 'Pie Chart Widget' region is found.

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes (including component layout validation), and npm run lint and npm run build are clean

complexity.rationale: A new component with computed SVG geometry and a data-derived accessible text list, plus a HomeView change. No state, API or dependency change.
